snapshot.baseline: Proposed OpenAPI 3.1.1 v2 surface; implementation verification pending

records.name: POST /api/v2/onboarding/sessions
records.authentication: None; response issues a separate guest proof credential

records.name: PUT /api/v2/onboarding/sessions/{session_id}/assessment
records.authentication: Guest proof credential; session ID alone is insufficient

records.name: POST /api/v2/onboarding/sessions/{session_id}/claim
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token plus guest proof credential

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/profile
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; subject maps to internal user

records.name: PATCH /api/v2/me/profile
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token

records.name: POST /api/v2/plan-generations
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/plan-generations/latest
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; owner derived server-side
records.notes: Returns the deterministic latest (created_at, id descending) plan_generation job for the authoritative profile-local date or supplied date, including terminal jobs; 404 reveals no cross-owner existence.

records.name: GET /api/v2/jobs/{job_id}
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; job owner match required

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/plans/today
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/plans/{plan_id}
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; plan owner match required

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/plans/{plan_id}/items/{item_id}/events
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; plan/item owner match required
records.notes: Unit-tested only; staging verification remains required.

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/plans/{plan_id}/items/{item_id}/feedback
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; plan/item owner match required

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/plans/{plan_id}/replacements
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; plan and requested item owner match required
records.idempotency: Required; replay returns the accepted replacement
records.notes: Only a selected already-published variant is supported. This operation does not call an AI provider; provider-backed replacement remains pending an owner-approved durable runner.

records.name: PUT /api/v2/me/plans/{plan_id}/daily-review
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; plan owner match required
records.notes: A review is accepted only after its immutable plan local date closes. It atomically records one earned/missed streak fact and grants one point only for an all-completed review; PostgreSQL and staging verification remains required.

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/progress/summary
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token
records.notes: Current day is explicitly provisional; staging verification remains required.

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/conversations
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token
records.notes: Opaque stable keyset cursor is unit-tested; staging verification remains required.

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/conversations
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/conversations/{conversation_id}
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; conversation owner match required
records.notes: Messages are bounded and keyset-paged; staging verification remains required.

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; conversation owner match required
records.notes: Persists the user message, job and outbox atomically. No assistant-response worker is implemented yet.

records.name: GET /api/v2/me/weekly-checkins/due
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/weekly-checkins
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token
records.notes: Locks the owner profile row to serialize same-user/week creation.

records.name: PUT /api/v2/me/weekly-checkins/{checkin_id}/responses/{question_id}
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; check-in owner match required

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/weekly-checkins/{checkin_id}/complete
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token; check-in owner match required

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/symptom-observations
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token
records.notes: Owner is derived from the verified principal; staging verification remains required.

records.name: POST /api/v2/me/exports
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token with signed recent-auth claim; fails closed when unavailable
records.notes: Queues a private export with object reference and checksum only. Live storage adapter and staging proof remain open.

records.name: DELETE /api/v2/me
records.authentication: Verified Firebase token with signed recent-auth claim and required receipt-HMAC secret
records.notes: Queues a resumable erasure ledger. Legal retention decision, external adapters and live zero-remnant proof remain open.

records.name: GET /health/live
records.authentication: None; reveals no dependency details

records.name: GET /health/ready
records.authentication: None; response is deliberately minimal
